description: Fetch statistically-validated leading/lagging relationships for an indicator. Source: the five-filter leading-indicator scanner (cross-correlation → first-differenced CCF → multi-crisis validation → Granger causality → out-of-sample validation). Returns two lists: `as_leader` (pairs where this indicator precedes its follower) and `as_follower` (pairs where another indicator precedes this one). Only fully-validated pairs are included — partial matches are not surfaced. Most of the 121 indicators return empty lists; only a handful of pairs clear the full gauntlet.

slug.description: The kebab-case indicator slug to look up (e.g., 'the-buffer', 'initial-unemployment-claims-sa'). Returns split lists of pairs where this indicator is the leader vs the follower. Empty lists are common — only fully-validated pairs surface.
slug.title: Slug
